title: VoxelMorph
paper_title: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration
core_mech: 3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。
core_mech_en: Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.
input_desc: 移动图像 m 与固定图像 f
input_en: Pair of 3D moving volume m and fixed volume f
output_desc: 稠密形变 phi 及配准图像 m∘phi
output_en: Dense 3D deformation field φ = Id + u (or velocity field integrated via scaling-and-squaring) and warped volume m ∘ φ

adapter.name: VoxelMorph
adapter.mechanism: A 3D encoder-decoder predicts a dense displacement; image similarity plus spatial smoothness trains through warping.
limitations: Reduced U-Net, known synthetic translations and normalized coordinates; no pretrained VoxelMorph or diffeomorphic integration.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
